proposals.evidence: Turner *sphuṭyati explicitly records the regional phuṭ-/phūṭ- break/burst verb, including Oriya phuṭibā, Gujarati phuṭvũ and Marathi phuṭṇẽ. These broken-state responses are its ordinary participial/past forms, retaining regional deaspiration and l-past or -ta endings. Both alternatives in the selected paired responses express the same verb family.
